title: Recommendation 100%
text:
It was just wonderful!!!
From the time of booking we had contact. 
A good feeling 😊
Picked up at the hotel we went into the narrow streets of the Barri Gòtic. 
Strolling around Barcelona, stopping at beautiful tapas bars, enjoying Spanish food - a perfect start to our weekend in this great city!😎
author: Rita H

title: Perfect start to a Barcelona stay!
text: Michael gave us a wonderful food and history tour in Barcelona. He showed us beautiful squares that we never would have found. The food was all wonderful and personalized for us, ending with the best churros! We did this tour on our first day in Barcelona (a few hours after our red eye from the US) and it was the perfect way to kick off our first visit to Spain!
author: melissava2
